The ticket authenticates the session's Phoenix socket `session:<id>` `connect/3` on the engine — it is NOT the reused JWT. 30s TTL and single use: every reconnection (including automatic ones) requests a new ticket. `scope: "heartbeat"` requires the `viewer` role; `scope: "terminal"` requires `developer`, the same minimum role as terminal actions.
